text:
harper: quick flag Galileo v1 onboarding eval has locale regressions: zh token merges and arabic/hebrew bracket mirroring. BLEU for zh/ko dropped ~8-12% on our small slice.
sneha: do you have short repros?
harper: pasting tiny cases that reproduce locally.

```
input (zh): 我们去了公园，孩子们玩得很开心。
gold (en): We went to the park; the kids had a great time.
pred (en): We went to the park the kids had very fun
```

harper: tokenization diff shows on-board normalizer collapsed punctuation tokens into neighbors. training tokenizer ran with no unicode normalization.
dmitri: any rtl example?
harper: yes:
```
input (he): שלום (המשפט) 
gold (en): Hello (the sentence)
pred (en): Hello )the sentence(
```
harper: looks like mirroring or removal of RLM/LRM marks in preproc.
sneha: is this only on q5 quant or also fp16?
harper: seen on both; q5 amplifies the merges so BLEU impact larger. fp16 still shows bracket reorder sometimes.
ops-bot: eval-runner-2001: galileo-v1 multilingual sweep (n=2k) completed  210 flagged samples (regression threshold 5%). Report: s3://rwd-evals/galileo/v1/2999999999/report.json
dmitri: plan: 1) revert onboard normalizer to match training (disable NFC/NFKC, collapse-zwsp off), 2) run 200-sample canary with kvcache traces, 3) q5 vs fp16 side-by-side to isolate quant tokenizer kernel issues.
sneha: I'll add a bidi unit test for bracket/quote mirroring and a locale BLEU per-language check (zh/ko/he/ar) with a lower alert threshold (2%).
harper: uploaded token diffs to s3://rwd-evals/galileo/v1/token-diffs/2999999999 (includes train vs onboard tokens). kicking off bisect now, tagging @sneha @dmitri. will post canary link when ready. :thumbsup:
